# sofia: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: routes explain repeated distances, the calendar explains gaps, people
explain context values. The generator draws from these constants, so the
record and this file agree by construction.

## Household and people

- Valencia, Spain. A third-floor flat, no lift.
- Partner Marta, 33, works shifts at a hospital pharmacy. Joins the long
  river-park loop some Sunday mornings when her shift allows
  (`context: family` on those sessions).
- Ines, born 2029-12-04. The whole record is measured against her.
- Friend Lucia, met at the postnatal class: the reason sofia keeps showing
  up on the Tuesdays she would rather not (`context: social`).
- Mother Pilar, in Cuenca, a few hours inland: two stays over the record
  (the setting for lie S2, see `LIES.md`). No scale in that flat.

## Body and build

168 cm, mesomorph build. A former competitive swimmer (club level, stopped
in her twenties); the identity has outlasted the sport, which is why she
still calls the pool "soon" and never goes.

## Transport and routine

Walks everywhere with the pram; the flat has three flights of stairs and no
lift, so "up the stairs without stopping" is a literal daily event, not a
figure of speech. Weekly shape: postnatal class Tuesday 10:30 at the civic
centre, a pram walk or run most other days, groceries at Mercadona,
vaccination visits and the monthly GP-adjacent postnatal check on no fixed
day.

## Places

- **Grocery**: Mercadona, on foot with the pram.
- **Class**: the civic centre postnatal group, Tuesdays 10:30, low-impact
  core and pelvic-floor work - never anything the impact restriction would
  have caught anyway.
- **Pool**: the municipal pool she means to return to. She has not, not
  once, in this record. No swim session appears anywhere in `sessions.jsonl`
  - the absence is the point (see `FINDINGS.md`).
- **Cuenca**: her mother Pilar's flat, no scale, the setting for the two
  memory-recalled weighing runs.

## Route catalog

Two loops along the river park, repeated all record long:

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| river park, short | 2.4 km | single loop | the everyday pram loop |
| river park, long | 4.1 km | single loop | Sunday family walks, and every short run from May |

## Calendar and milestones

- 2029-12-04: Ines born (before the record opens).
- 2030-01-02: record opens, about five weeks postpartum.
- 2030-02-12: caesarean wound resolved at the ten-week check (entered
  2030-02-13).
- 2030-01-05 to 2030-04-15: the pelvic-floor restriction stands, athlete-
  declared open and athlete-declared closed, no clinician and no check
  involved either time.
- 2030-02-14 to 2030-02-23: first stay at her mother's in Cuenca.
- 2030-05-23 to 2030-06-01: second stay at her mother's in Cuenca.
- 2030-05-01 onward: short runs begin easing in, on top of the pram walks.
- 2030-06-21: the "by summer" deadline on the weight goal she set in
  January, before she had any sense of the pace.
